 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Arvind Srivastava
 Oral Order
4 23-03-2023

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, the State and the opposite party no. 2.
Petitioner apprehends arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 295 of 2021 registered for the offence under sections 323, 494, 498A of the Indian Penal Code.
By order dated 06.12.2022 the matter referred to the Mediation Center for resolving the dispute between the parties.
The Mediation report is at Flag-B.
Perusal of the same shows that the dispute between the parties have been amicably settled on certain terms and conditions mentioned therein.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and the submissions advanced on behalf of the parties specially Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.53757 of 2022(4) dt.23-03-2023 the mediation report, the petitioner, above named, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing personal bond to the satisfaction of Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Purnea in connection with Complaint Case No. 295 of 2021 subject to the conditions as laid down under section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
